status: pre-run protocol; no supplemental outcomes are claimed

common_settings.calibration_note: XS conformal score banks are trained at persistence w=0; clean-H0 operating thresholds are recalibrated separately at each requested persistence level. Achieved test PFA must be reported and is not forced to equal 0.05.

B2_rho_cap.purpose: Rho dose-response and exclusion-cap sensitivity, with a fixed 50/50 extreme/mild masking mixture.

B2_extreme_mild_split.purpose: Separate the extreme/mild composition effect from rho at rho=0.2 and 0.4.
B2_extreme_mild_split.telemetry: seed-level only; detailed B5 telemetry is a separate replay of the first 48 seeds at -9 dB

B5_telemetry_replay.purpose: Per-user attacker ranking, decisions, catch by subtype, and displacement decomposition.
B5_telemetry_replay.telemetry: full user observations, user decisions, and displacement; exact replay subset of B2_extreme_mild_split; do not pool duplicate rows into inferential n

B6_B7_B8_B9_comparators.purpose: Baseline comparison, corrected OracleRemoval calibration, clean/no-attack operating behavior, and ROC/matched-PFA analysis.
B6_B7_B8_B9_comparators.telemetry: round-level fused statistics retained for ROC; user-level telemetry skipped

B10_persistence.purpose: Persistence stress comparison at w=0, 0.5, and 0.9.

analysis_status.B1_V3_primary: completed independently; frozen and excluded from new experiment runs
analysis_status.confirmatory_claims: B1-V3 primary results remain the only confirmatory primary contrasts. Supplemental factorial and baseline analyses are additional reviewer-requested analyses and will be labeled accordingly.

baseline_disclosure.BetaHistory: Existing study-adapted Beta-Bernoulli anomaly-history comparator; not claimed as exact reproduction of a cited paper.
baseline_disclosure.BDFHistory: New study-adapted windowed Beta peer-consistency comparator inspired by the reputation component of Wu et al. (2024), Electronics 13, 3386, DOI 10.3390/electronics13173386. It is not an exact reproduction of their full weighted sequential likelihood-ratio procedure.
baseline_disclosure.Huber: Adaptive Huber M-estimator of location with IRLS weights; per-round robust location comparator.
baseline_disclosure.OracleRemoval: Calibrated on clean H0 after removing a random subset of exactly L reports per calibration seed, where L matches the requested rho; at test it removes known attacker identities. Oracle is an upper-bound reference, not an implementable detector.
